title: Audit complete candidate representation in the seven-source search
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

PR3244 checks propagation but explicitly leaves search/template completeness open. This package proves that every simple restored universal word in the pinned A/B multiplicity classes has a representation in the source's low templates, compressed high paths, gap vectors and initial domains. It adds a written representation argument and an independently implemented exact checker; no source defect was found in this scope.

The key new implication is that replacing a high path by its `(visited set, endpoint, coordinate counts)` representative preserves the whole word's prefix set, restoration, simplicity and multiplicities. Exact enumeration verifies the surrounding finite domains. This is a scoped proof/audit, not a completed search, full `f(7)=24` validation, supplier admission or new kappa.

## Task and overlap

- Task `census-pruning-audit`, priority revision 6, **refined** to `connector-covering-code-simple-ab-domain-completeness`. [Task card and complete proof](https://github.com/krzysztofwojt/integer-mult-bounds/tree/aa47cff758c956304327f1fc67dac61e970cfb3d/research/connector-domain-completeness).
- Scientific and refreshed canonical main: `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. Contribution commit: `aa47cff758c956304327f1fc67dac61e970cfb3d`. Final fetch found no relevant upstream changes.
- Executable subject: conorholds' `research/connector-covering-code/cycle_search.cpp`, SHA256 `597844fc32cde19c1d4104633fa6d3eb0d28c1ca140f8f3d2ba2cb632ecd30d1`.
- Nearest work: #3224 (`69567e40e8d92542248eda0d6a400d83adc1d3a3`, capacity) and #3244 (`5964d7f22ad9cd9c27a1d2eb0b897f52b9425a13`, propagation/emitted-template incidence). This closes their explicitly untested representation step; their executables are not imported or rerun.
- [Canonical claim/handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1317#discussioncomment-19003334). Final overlap refresh covers 306 open PRs at 19:40:57 UTC and 2,093 Discussion records at 19:42:26 UTC, with complete pagination and no warnings, plus matching local packages and live #1317. No matching successor surfaced; unpublished work and arbitrary closed diffs remain outside coverage.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/connector-domain-completeness
python3.12 -I -O -B research/connector-domain-completeness/verify.py --controls
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/connector-domain-completeness
```

All pass on macOS arm64, CPython 3.12.12, Apple Clang 21.0.0. Exact evidence:

- All 2,520 A and 18,900 B labeled low words, yielding exactly 5/77 universal symmetry orbits; all 82 native constructors execute.
- All 112 simple Q3 paths, exactly 106 quotient classes and 848 translations; 48 translated full-word replacement controls.
- 256 initial-domain comparisons and every 102,552 A / 286,780 B gap vector, compared as complete ordered streams, with an independent count identity.
- Four compiled semantic mutants (missing orbit, discarded path counts, wrong carried parity, omitted gap seven) and three truncation/source-correspondence controls reject.
- Metadata/source pins, staged whitespace check, all nine committed package/input byte comparisons, archive integrity and optimized read-only Git-free export replay pass. A separate AI worker's independent low-word/path enumeration and targeted proof review agree with the primary results.

Catalogue/initial-domain checks compile unchanged authenticated source. Gap checks use two explicit, uniqueness-checked instrumentation replacements to capture the original recursive loop before capacity or word search; this is documented and is not a full native census. The dedicated Linux workflow declares the C++17 build; hosted CI is separate from the local evidence.

Unrun: full B exhaustion, complete branching/exhaustion validation, literature/classification and multiplicity premises, the non-simple branch, formal-kernel proof, selected cold replay and physical supplier obligations. Selected records, frozen predecessors and shared tools are unchanged.

## Credit

Submitted for @krzysztofwojt with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, checking and writing; a Luna worker supplied read-only overlap extraction and separate low-word/path enumeration. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. New material is Apache-2.0.

Credit conorholds for the source search; commdata2338/#3224 and Nick Petalas/#3244 for the audits and handoff; Nicholas Stone, Aaron Wang, James Reed, Ross Richardson and Douglas Colkitt for the retained parity, engine, model and framework lineage. Original notices and evidence remain intact.

## Open next questions

The README/TASK give the next bounded test: compare `Engine::search` against a small explicit Cartesian-domain oracle with satisfying, unsatisfiable and interrupted cases, then bind all template IDs/flags to complete source-pinned exhaustion receipts. That missing implication should be checked before a separately budgeted independent full B replay. Domain completeness alone does not establish an exclusion.
